introHtml: 10 oz diner restaurant mugs offer a classic, no-fuss size that’s ideal for serving standard coffee or tea portions without waste. Perfect for cafes, diners, or break rooms, these mugs provide a comfortable, familiar grip and stack neatly for storage. Customize with your logo using screen printing or full-color imprint to create a durable, everyday piece that keeps your brand top-of-mind with every sip.
